candidate_rule: Only systems passing both frozen temporal S3 and temporal prune-only informativeness enter spatial simulation.

eligibility_reconstruction.rule: Reconstruct the pre-frozen spatially qualifying species identities using the v0.3.3 semantic predicates; raw trait values/categories may be used only inside SQL predicates/count-distinct operations that determine eligibility and are never returned to the simulator.
eligibility_reconstruction.continuous: numeric-valid records; geovalid; non-centroid; non-county-centroid; >=20 records; >=5 frozen cells; >=2 distinct numeric states
eligibility_reconstruction.categorical: nonmissing categorical records; geovalid; non-centroid; non-county-centroid; >=20 records; >=5 frozen cells; >=2 distinct categories

simulator_input_only: species identity used only as a deterministic seed key
record multiplicity at exact duplicate coordinates
coordinate_duplicate_rule: Collapse exact duplicate latitude/longitude to one node with multiplicity while preserving the expanded unordered pair multiset algebraically.
distance_normalization: Weighted median of positive great-circle distances over the original expanded record-pair multiset; duplicate-coordinate zero distances are excluded from the positive median exactly as frozen.

weighted_pair_spearman.separation_rank: Exact multiplicity-weighted midranks corresponding to the fully expanded original unordered record-pair set.
weighted_pair_spearman.continuous_dissimilarity_rank: Exact multiplicity-weighted midranks of absolute synthetic state differences; within-coordinate duplicate pairs have zero dissimilarity.
weighted_pair_spearman.categorical: Exact weighted Pearson correlation of fixed separation ranks with the binary mismatch indicator; affine equivalence makes this identical to Spearman with tied 0/1 mismatch ranks.

spatial_gp_factorization.factorization: unpivoted Cholesky of the symmetric covariance matrix
spatial_gp_factorization.failure_rule: If exact covariance factorization fails, that species geometry is invalid for the replicate axis; do not add a nugget or alter the generator.

family_replicate_rule.family_effect: median of finite species-level synthetic delta_rho values when at least 8 species are finite
family_replicate_rule.rationale: Uses the already-frozen spatial minimum of 8 species rather than inventing a new post-result threshold.

calibration_and_evaluation: Use the same lambda grid, 200-pilot common-random-number calibration, 0.15 target, 1000 evaluation replicates, MAE<=0.10, directional>=0.80 and valid-fraction>=0.90 rules frozen in v0.4.1/v0.4.2.
deterministic_seed: FNV-1a 32-bit over master_seed|family|trait|spatial|species|phase; lambda is excluded so candidate lambda values share innovations.
